stack.why: one row per pointer, plain SQL

ix_ptr.schema:
CREATE TABLE pointer (
  doc_id text PRIMARY KEY,
  tenant_id text NOT NULL,
  uri text NOT NULL,
  version text NOT NULL,
  content_hash text NOT NULL,
  acl_version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  deleted_at timestamptz
);
ix_ptr.interface: def upsert_pointer(p: Pointer) -> bool  # True if applied, False if a newer version already won
ix_ptr.code:
def upsert_pointer(conn, p):
    cur = conn.execute(
        '''INSERT INTO pointer(doc_id,tenant_id,uri,version,content_hash,acl_version)
           VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s)
           ON CONFLICT (doc_id) DO UPDATE SET version=EXCLUDED.version,
             content_hash=EXCLUDED.content_hash, acl_version=EXCLUDED.acl_version
           WHERE pointer.version < EXCLUDED.version''',
        (p.doc_id,p.tenant_id,p.uri,p.version,p.content_hash,p.acl_version))
    return cur.rowcount == 1
